notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
I hope using Unreal Engine 5.5 won't cause any issues. I'm encountering serious lighting problems, and optimizing the game is quite challenging. The biggest issue is that I used to use general lighting for illumination in version 5.2, and there were no problems there. Now, if I use general lighting and Lumen is not enabled, everything turns grayish. In the first image, you can see the grayish areas with Lumen turned off. If there's no lighting, everything becomes gray. Anyway, I think I'll stop using general lighting for now and switch to normal lighting (at least for the time being, as general lighting was good for FPS, but normal lighting enhances the atmosphere of the game). Apart from that, I want to take a bit more time in the development process to add more beautiful elements. What do you think the name of the game should be? Alpha Rooms, Alpha Layers, or Layers? Feel free to suggest different ideas in the comments.

notes.title: Project Upgrade and Renewal
notes.content: I upgraded the project to Unreal Engine 5.4. The game has some performance issues, but I will fix them. Integration took some time and the game plan in my head has just settled. The game will be in survival genre. The player will be able to choose 3 different characters, researcher, explorer, ranger. You will have 3 lives. If you die with one character, you will have to save it with the other character. And if you manage to get him back to the old base, you will be able to play that character again. The explorer saves the data of objects at level 0 and returns to the base, which is then used by the explorer to build the base. the ranger is the only character who can use a weapon (you can usually use it for rescue missions). In the game you will need to eat and drink water. The map in the game will always be fixed, so even if you discover new places, those places will still be there when you close and open the game. So don't save immediately when you see a creature in the game and it starts running at you :D. I'm trying to finish the project before the end of my winter break (February 7), I hope it will be finished, if not, I feel that something good will happen. New devlog is coming soon :).

notes.title: Alpha Rooms 0.0.1.4 Update Notes
notes.content:
How's it going, friends! I hope everything is good. And finally, the long-awaited 0.0.1.4 update is out. You can watch the video (where I mostly talked about the new features, I’ll cover the bug fixes now) or check out the notes I’ll share below:

* Twig dancer (Level 0) sound and range have been reduced (it used to sound like it was screaming too close)
* Chunk loading system improved (continue moving even if the chunk hasn’t loaded, it will load 90% of the time)
* Robots in the Space level can now shoot from farther away
* Lightsabers now spawn more correctly
* Void Maw (Level 0) sound and range have been reduced
* Paths in the Garden level now form more organized shapes
* Gary (Level 3) dialogue lines are now better and more dynamic (opacity decreases or increases based on range)
* Increased ball spawn time in the Game level (from 0.25 to 0.75)
* Added demonic voices to hallucinations
* A new hostile entity has been added to the Pool level
* Pause menu can now be closed with Esc
* Holo menu can be closed with Q
* Stamina bar appears while running (if the helper face is active)
* Reorganized some buttons in the menu
* Fixed missing SFX sounds
* You can now choose the atmosphere yourself (Normal, Horror, No Effects) details are in the video
* If you fall into the void without collecting an anomaly, a new animation plays
* Added crouching and sliding mechanics
* Added a hiding mechanic (you can hide in metal lockers inside the level)
* Monsters could kill you even while in the elevator, this issue has been fixed
* Added a dynamic menu that changes based on the level (Details in the video)
* Added a night vision feature (you can find anomalies with it)
* Increased the flashlight range and area, but reduced its power
* Increased stamina regeneration speed
* Fixed an issue where melee attacking AIs wouldn’t attack until they got close
* Filled in the Documents section
* Changed the spawning systems for Black Holes and Elevators. Elevators now spawn less frequently.

notes.title: 0.0.1.4 Planning Update
notes.content:
In this update, I will try to fix bugs in the game based on the feedback I received. I'll leave a list for the next update below:

*The volume and audibility of Bacteria in yellow rooms will be reduced.
*Chunk loading system will be updated, bugs will be minimized.
*Targeting abilities of robots in the space room will be improved.
*Fix lightsaber spawn system (some spawn inside the wall).
*Reduce the sound and audibility of octopuses in the yellow rooms.
*Wall inscriptions in yellow rooms will be changed. More appropriate inscriptions will be added to the lore.
*The boat will be made drivable on the sea level.
*Improving the generation system in the Garden level.
*The inscription for the enemy in the Forest level will be improved (it doesn't calculate the distance well; the opacity of the inscription needs to be changed accordingly).
*Increase the spawn time of the cannon in the game level (from 0.25 to 0.75).
*Special details will be added to the hallucination effect (making it scarier and more impressive).
*The first 9 Chunks will no longer have elevators or gaps (to encourage the player to move around a bit more).
*The chance to spawn enemies in the first Chunk will be reset.
*A new enemy will be added to the pool level (I'm thinking a creature that can fly :) ).
*Pressing the Escape key will now open and close the pause menu.
*Holo can be turned on and off by pressing the Q key.
*When the assist UI is activated, the stamina bar will appear on the left when running and health will appear when taking damage (so you can return to normal gameplay even if the assist UI is on, the current one is too bad :D).
*Some menu button locations will be updated.
*Missing sound effects will be completed, more vivid sounds will be added.
*You will be able to adjust the Post Process effect yourself (Normal, Horrible, No Effect). The gameplay and atmosphere will change according to the settings you choose.
*Improvements to the falling to the ground when you move to a new level (It will be made a little more cinematic and realistic).
*Ducking mechanic will be added and new challenges and mechanics will be added accordingly.
*Hide mechanic will be added.
*Fix the bug where enemies can kill even if the player is in the elevator.

I hope I can complete them all by the end of the month :D

notes.title: Alpha Rooms (0.0.1.3) Update
notes.content:
Before diving into the update details, I’d like to share a few things with you. Alpha Rooms has now entered its 3rd month of development, and I hope this journey has been as enjoyable for you as it has been for me. Reaching this point from the first updates shows how much the game has truly evolved.

However, due to sales falling far below my expectations and the accounting costs of the game company I founded, this might be our final update. September will be a decisive month for me. I’m planning to focus more on marketing to increase the game’s sales and reverse this negative trend.

Thank you all for being with me on this journey. I have one small request from you: please share Alpha Rooms, tell your friends, or create content on social media platforms to help the game survive. I’m truly grateful to everyone who has played and supported the game so far. I hope we can reach our goal of level 100 together! :)

Update Notes for Version 0.0.1.3:

*Color balance in the levels has been improved (some areas are warmer, while others are cooler, making the atmosphere more appealing).
*The Space room has been updated and completely revamped.
*Some UI elements have been changed.
*I’ve added a Wooden Boat to Level 6.
*Adjusted the speech bubble colors of the creature in Level 3 (now it’s more readable).
*Terrain modeling in Level 7 has been changed (now it resembles Backrooms Level 94 a bit more).
*A control interface has been added to the pause menu (showing Keyboard-Gamepad buttons).
*A “No Monsters” mode has been introduced (you can turn off monsters in the settings to relax and explore freely).
*The iconic “Bacteria” character from Backrooms has been added to Level 0 (I’ve added a little personal touch to the character).
*Minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: 0.0.1.1 Story and Level 0 Expansion
notes.content:
Update 0.0.1.1

With this update, the game introduces a new quest (the first step in the game's storytelling), new formation variations for Level 0, the return of the old version of Level 1, and the addition of an elevator mechanic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45054947/41660fbf3369188d2a9960b47fc6881225fd4e0e.png[/img]

To complete the new quest, you must find the command center in Level 0. Then, investigate inside and explore other levels to find what you need. To help you, pressing "Q" will now activate an object finder in Holo, which will turn green as you get closer to the required objects. You can also find audio logs in Holo (if you complete the quest, of course).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45054947/ed68f3ef3a217db8168601caeeb31e2d888e26a9.png[/img]

The elevator will allow you to travel up and down between levels. You no longer need to go from Level 1 to Level 2; you can return to Level 0 if you wish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45054947/d498f12b8fbd2e608ce49b2b6cb534154ac56e86.png[/img]

Level 1 has been updated again. I think it might be updated again in the next update. I still feel like I haven't captured the right atmosphere. You can join our Discord community or leave comments to give feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45054947/04cf73235cc08b305b27fcdbbd16dc0c4b1ce33c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45054947/e98ae82e7ce38d18799153b2067f26a12d801c11.png[/img]

I’ve added star-shaped walls and house room concepts to Level 0. Roaming Level 0 has never been this nice.
